source.prompt: Seamless tileable texture, square, 2048x2048. Orthographic top-down view, a flat, front-on decorative panel filling the whole frame edge to edge. Flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Flat, front-on decorative panel of Kimr Stone-Age lapidary mosaic set in dark pine-pitch mastic alongside twined wild-turkey feather trim: tightly fitted hand-ground rectangular tesserae of matrix-veined sky-blue turquoise (#2fa0a6, brown host veins #5a4634), polished black jet (#1c1c1e), warm orange-red spiny-oyster shell (#c85228), and cream clam shell (#e6decb) forming stepped labyrinth bands above a lower border of coppery-soot wild-turkey contour feathers (#3a2e26, #785238, buff tips #d8ceb8), strictly zero metal bezels. Full colour.
